iti33:2.1: dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
iti33:2.3: bhaddakena ca sīlena bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyā
iti33:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
iti33:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
